description: HDC memory test fixture corpus for deduplication, heartbeat novelty, and search fusion

exact-duplicate-different-path.rationale: Identical content byte-for-byte; only path differs. Path (weight 2) pulls vectors apart from 1.0; measured ~0.819. Falls in 'similar' band [0.78, 0.92) with default thresholds.

reformatted-duplicate.rationale: Same information with different markdown formatting (bullets vs paragraphs, header levels). HDC n-gram encoding sees through most formatting changes; measured ~0.848. Falls in 'similar' band with default thresholds.

paraphrase-duplicate.rationale: Same facts restated with different word choices and sentence structure; measured ~0.782. Sits in the 'similar' band [0.78, 0.92) with default thresholds -- surface-form changes prevent reaching 'duplicate'.

added-paragraph.rationale: Entry 2 is a strict superset of entry 1. High overlap but not identical; measured ~0.876. Falls in 'similar' band [0.78, 0.92) with default thresholds.

same-topic-different-facts.rationale: Both about async Rust concurrency with identical tags and similar vocabulary. Tag weight (3/10) plus shared n-grams keep similarity elevated; measured ~0.718. Below the 0.78 'similar' threshold, so classified as 'unique'.

same-tags-different-content.rationale: Shared tags (rust, database) and similar path structure pull similarity up; measured ~0.777. Just below the 0.78 'similar' threshold, classified as 'unique'.

same-path-pattern-different-content.rationale: Shared path prefix and identical tags provide strong tag+path similarity. Content differs (Alpha frontend vs Beta API migration); measured ~0.715. Below the 0.78 'similar' threshold.

content-subset.rationale: Entry 1 is fully contained in entry 2. The shared n-grams from the subset push similarity above 0.78; measured ~0.807. Falls in 'similar' band with default thresholds.

translated-content.rationale: Same semantic content in different natural languages. Identical tags (rust, memory) and shared technical terms provide some signal, but cross-language n-grams differ substantially; measured ~0.767. Below the 0.78 'similar' threshold.

expected_novelty_at_cycle.reason: Fifth exact repeat, staleness should be high
First occurrence of disk space warning
Disk space warning returns after 20-cycle gap; HDC memory should still recognize it
Same sentence structure with only a numeric value changed (85% vs 92%); byte-trigram HDC cannot distinguish a single number change and scores similarity >= 0.80 threshold
Sentence structure identical ('Disk utilization at 85% on /...'); changing only the last few path bytes (/data vs /logs) is not enough to cross the novelty threshold in byte-trigram HDC
